Mind blowing breakfast experience.
Oct 2024 • Family
This is definitely one of the best Hilton Breakfast in South East Asia. My family of 6 dined at the restaurant for breakfast. The impressively huge spread was eye pleasing and sumptuous. From local fare to international choices, it is more than enough to whet any hunger pangs.

For myself, my croissant was so buttery and flaky. The great selections of pastries and bread were so good that i almost had half a loaf. While it is not the best pho and banh mi. I really indulged myself in such spread.

For drinks, the beetroot juice were so good that it cleansed my palate making ways for delicious local coffee and barista latte. All drinks were so good for a coffee freak like me. While writing this, i can't even wait a second further for my second breakfast tomorrow.

Last but not least, Lan, the executive chef as well as Tom and Hieu, along with Dash, Duyen, Nhung and Nhi made my day. I have no qualms to say that Braserrie Nam Restaurant is the best Hilton for breakfast in the South East Asia regions.

A great breakfast experience, in my books.
Jun 2024 • Family
Great experience with the Continental Breakfast Buffet every morning during the entirety of my stay here in Da Nang City.

I call it a good gastronomic "barrage" in my books. From the hors d'oeuvres & canapes (my fave being the cured, smoked Basa Fish. And the cheese variants, too), to the big breakfast classics, then salads, pastries/desserts, and all the way to smoothies, juices and Vietnamese Coffee variants (as the ultimate finisher), I was personally mind-blown with my breakfast experience for five straight days, and for the record, I am glad to have even met the executive chef himself, Mr. Lan Nguyen. Kudos to you and your excellent staff, namely June, Tom, and there's one newbie (female in black uniform) whose name I just forgot. Everyone was helpful as well All good. Cảm ơn rất nhiều! 😃
